title: the_player_below_me
beats: There's a parkour map I've been speedrunting for two years, and every night at exactly 3 AM, a second player joins my world.
I play solo. Singleplayer. No realms, no LAN, nothing.
The first time it happened, I thought it was a bug — just a name tag, 'GUEST_04,' floating on the course below mine.
I ignored it. Kept jumping. Then GUEST_04 started completing the exact jumps I'd just failed on, one second behind me, every single time.
Not the same route. My route. My missed jumps, corrected.
I built a wall to block the entrance to my course. Next login, the wall was gone, and there was a sign where it used to stand.
It said: 'You already made it. I'm just walking you through it again.'
I checked my world's play time that night — it read 4,000 hours. I've played this world for maybe 80.
I deleted the save. Reinstalled Minecraft. Made a brand new world, different name, different seed.
This time there was no course. Just GUEST_04, standing still, facing me, in a world that had existed for six minutes.
I sent this clip to my brother before I closed the game for good.
He said he's seen that name before — in a world of his that he deleted three years ago.
If it's not a bug, and it's not a hacker... what is it walking me through?
